title: LLMs Homogenize Values in Constructive Arguments on Value-Laden Topics

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating and comparing underlying human values in human-written versus LLM-rewritten comments using Schwartz's theory of basic human values to detect systematic shifts away from Conservative values (Tradition, Security) toward progressive and prosocial values (Universalism, Benevolence).

Comparing the value expressions in comments generated by participants from India (collectivist) and the United States (individualist) to evaluate how LLM-driven value homogenization overrides distinct cultural norms and favors Western-centric values.
